category: managed private Stremio addon instance (debrid key passthrough, optional proxy streaming)

free_tier.stated: No free tier for a private instance, but a free public instance of each addon exists with lower limits: 'we offer free highly-available hosting for addons, with rate-limits to prevent abuse ... subscription-based instances are also available with 10 x higher rate-limits'. The paid products carry 'Free trial: 7 days' and 'Sign-up fee: $1.00'.
free_tier.notes: The trial is USD 1 down, not free: 'Try it for $1, 7 days, cancel anytime.'

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an addon instance, not a stored object

retention.stated: not applicable: the instance keeps configuration, not media

egress.terms: Sold by stream, not by byte: the MediaFlow-Proxy booster is priced as bandwidth, 'Adds 256 Mbps of proxy-streaming bandwidth to your MediaFlow Proxy subscription, enough for 4 concurrent HD streams or 2 concurrent 4K streams' at USD 9/month. Base instances include proxying but publish no bitrate figure.

interface_detail: A private instance reachable at its own HTTPS URL, installed in Stremio by pasting the manifest link; SSO protects the configure page. 'Private add-ons with 10x rate limits, plus bundled TorBox and usenet accounts'.
tooling: none needed client-side: configure in the browser, paste the manifest URL into Stremio Web or the Stremio app. The addon does the scraping and debrid calls server-side, which is what removes the need for a local streaming server.
chaining: This is the paid upgrade of the free public addons: it adds 10x rate limits, a dedicated IP for proxying ('protect your debrid account from multi-IP bans') and, in some variants, a bundled TorBox Essential or Usenet account.

limits.value: subscription instances get 10x the public instance's rate limits; the public figure itself is not published

limits_note: Only 10 addons show per page of 51 products, so the full catalogue was not enumerated. Each product is one instance; stacking Comet + MediaFusion + AIOStreams means stacking USD 9 subscriptions unless the USD 29 bundle covers them.
binding_note: At 1 TiB/month nothing byte-based binds - the bytes come from a user's debrid account - but every request the addon makes is counted against an unpublished rate limit, and that is the limit ElfHosted itself sells the upgrade on ('10x higher rate-limits').

identity_cost.detail: Store account plus payment. The addon still needs a user's own debrid key, so a debrid subscription is a second gate that ElfHosted does not remove.

reliability_note: Public instances are shared and rate-limited, and ElfHosted has retired a public instance before when upstream archived the project (WebStreamr, recorded separately). Private instances are sold as the fix for multi-IP debrid bans, so the ban risk is real on the public ones.
confidence_note: Category and Flex product pages read; the docs page and the public Comet configure page read. Not measured: a purchased private instance, so the '10x rate limits' and dedicted-IP ban protection are the vendor's claims and the public limit figure is unpublished.

evidence.proved: 51 products in the category, 10 shown; AIOStreams, AIOStreams+Stremthru, AIOStreams+MediaFlow, AIOStreams+NzbDAV, AIOStreams+TorBox, MediaFusion+MediaFlow, Comet+proxy and Usenet Streamer each 'USD 9.00 / month'; Stremio Addons Bundle 'USD 29.00 / month'; the MediaFlow Proxy 2x4K booster at USD 9 with '256 Mbps ... 4 concurrent HD streams or 2 concurrent 4K'
'we offer free highly-available hosting for addons, with rate-limits to prevent abuse' and 'subscription-based instances are also available with 10 x higher rate-limits'
the public instance's own upgrade pitch: 'Shared instances can't stream Usenet. Private ones can ... Try it for $1, 7 days, cancel anytime. ($9/mo after.)'

the billing shape these products share: 'USD 9.00 / month', 'Free trial: 7 days', 'Sign-up fee: USD 1.00', 3/6/12-month terms at USD 25.65 / 48.60 / 86.40, and that Flex's own collection excludes the media apps
reported, not read: a search index shows 'USD 9.00 / month with a 7-day free trial and a $1.00 sign-up fee'

notes: The bundle is the only place the vendor bundles somebody else's debrid capacity: 'Stremio Addons Bundle includes ... bundled third-party TorBox and Usenet provider accounts', and AIOStreams (with TorBox Essential) is USD 9 with the TorBox account inside. That makes USD 9 the cheapest single purchase found that includes both the addon and a debrid subscription, which is the whole pipeline in one line item.
